_comment: Account names are identifiers - they key the dotted key paths and regexes of tools that read fumes' output - so they must match [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*: no dots, spaces or punctuation.
_comment2: Go-plan percentages need no key of their own: fumes reuses the API key opencode keeps in auth.json. The service_key - a service account key from console.opencode.ai - is what unlocks the Zen spend row; without one that row is simply absent. console_url only matters with a service_key, and only if the export lives somewhere other than https://opencode.ai/console.
